source.primary_witnesses: **Greek (Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus + Syncellus Chronographia) PRESERVES SUBSTANTIAL PORTIONS of the geographical-land-division material in chs 8-9 — particularly the Shem/Ham/Japhet allotment-boundaries.** Where Greek preserves, Greek is a key secondary witness. 11Q12 not preserved at this chapter. Ge'ez (Charles 1902 + VanderKam 1989) is primary; Greek extracts where they parallel.
source.transliteration_convention: Hebrew SBL/Sefaria; Greek SBL (η→ē, ω→ō); Ge'ez SBL.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Dean 1935 Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus + Mosshammer 1984 Syncellus Chronographia + VanderKam 1989 + VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.fetchedFrom: Dean, J. E., Epiphanius' Treatise on Weights and Measures (Chicago 1935); Mosshammer, A. A., Syncelli ecloga chronographica (Leipzig 1984); VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; Charles 1902; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.citation: Dean 1935 Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus; Mosshammer 1984 Syncelli Chronographia; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia; Charles 1902; Alexander, P. S., 'Notes on the Imago Mundi of the Book of Jubilees' JJS 33 (1982) — foundational study of Jub 8-9 geography; Scott, J. M., Geography in Early Judaism and Christianity (Cambridge 2002).
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 8 — **THE TABLE OF NATIONS + THE LAND-DIVISION-BY-LOT.** **GREEK PATRISTIC WITNESS BEGINS HERE.** Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus preserves the divided-by-lot geographical descriptions of Shem (8:12-21), Ham (8:22-24), and Japhet (8:25-30). **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — JERUSALEM-AS-OMPHALOS / CENTER-OF-THE-EARTH** (Jub 8:12, 19) is bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `jerusalem-as-omphalos-center-of-the-earth-1-enoch-26-cross-corpus`. The Jubilees geography is a HELLENISTIC-ERA T-O MAP with Jerusalem at center; this is one of the most studied passages in Second Temple geography.

verses.text_geez: ወበ፳ ወ፱ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ነሥአ፡ አርፋክስድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ራሱኤያ፡ ወለተ፡ ሱሰን፡ ወለተ፡ ኤላም፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በ፫ ዓመት፡ በዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ኬናን፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-29 ʾiyobēləwu qadāmāwi sabuʿ qadāmi naśʾa ʾArfaksəd lottu bəʾəsita səmā Rāsuʾeyā walatta Susan walatta ʾElām bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-3 ʿāmat ba-zəntu sabuʿ wa-samayō səmō Kēnān
verses.notes: **Arpachshad's son KENAN — a Jubilees-distinctive interpolation.** Adds Kenan between Arpachshad and Shelah (Gen 11:12-13 MT has direct Arpachshad → Shelah, but LXX adds Kainan/Kenan).

verses.text_geez: ወልሕቀ፡ ወልድ፡ ወመሐሮ፡ አቡሁ፡ ጽሕፈተ፡ ወሖረ፡ ከመ፡ የኀሥሥ፡ ሎቱ፡ መካነ፡ ኀበ፡ ይምስት፡ ቤተ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወረከበ፡ ጽሕፈተ፡ ጥቅት፡ በውስተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ወአንበበ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ቦቱ፡ ወገለበቦ፡ ወአበሰ፡ ቦቱ፡
verses.translit: wa-ləḥqa walda wa-maḥaro ʾabbuhu ṣəḥfata wa-ḥora kama yəḫaśśəś lottu makāna ḫaba yəməsət bēta lottu wa-rakaba ṣəḥfata ṭəqt ba-wəsta kʷakwəḥ wa-ʾanbaba zaṣəḥuf bottu wa-galabbabō wa-ʾabasa bottu
verses.notes: **KENAN FINDS AN INSCRIPTION ON ROCK — the LOST WATCHERS' ASTROLOGICAL TEACHING.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — THE WATCHERS' TEACHINGS RECOVERED.** Kenan reads ancient rock-inscriptions teaching the celestial-divination of the pre-Flood Watchers. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 8:3 (Watchers teaching astrology, divination, sorcery); cf. Josephus Ant. 1.69-71 (Sethite pillars preserving astronomy through Flood — similar trope); cf. Pseudo-Eupolemus (preserved in Eusebius Praep. Ev. 9.17.8-9: Abraham learns astrology from Babylonian giants). **Kenan's recovery of forbidden Watcher-astrology is the Jubilees etiology of post-Flood Babylonian astrology.**

verses.text_geez: ወአበሰ፡ እስመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ትጉሃን፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ኪነ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ በውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትእምርት፡ ለሰማይ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾabasa ʾəsma bottu śərʿata Təguhānə zabottu kina ḍaḥay wa-warḫ wa-kawākəbt ba-wəsta kwəlu təʾəmərt la-samāy
verses.notes: **Inscription contained the OMEN-INTERPRETATION OF SUN, MOON, AND STARS.** **MAJOR — ASTRAL DIVINATION ETIOLOGY.** Kenan transmits forbidden Watcher-astrology. Cross-corpus: cf. 1 En 8:3 (Baraqel teaches signs of lightning, Kokabel teaches signs of stars, etc.); cf. Deut 18:9-14 (prohibition against divination).

verses.text_geez: ወጸሐፎ፡ ወኢዘንተ፡ ለመኑሂ፡ እስመ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ይብል፡ ለኖኅ፡ ለእመ፡ ይትመዐዕ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡
verses.translit: wa-ṣaḥafo wa-ʾi-zanta la-manuhi ʾəsma yəfarrəh yəbəl la-Noḫ la-ʾəmma yətmaʿʿə lāʿlēhu ba-ʾəntiʾahu
verses.notes: **Kenan writes it down but tells no one — afraid of Noah.** Hidden transmission of Watcher-knowledge.

verses.text_geez: ወበ፴ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በራብዕ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ መልካ፡ ወለተ፡ ምሉሐድ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሳላ፡ እስመ፡ ይቤ፡ በአማን፡ ተፈነውኩ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-30 ʾiyobēləwu ba-rābəʿ sabuʿ ba-qadāmāwi ʿāmat naśʾa lottu bəʾəsita səmā Malka walatta Məlluḫad bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat la-zəntu sabuʿ wa-samayō səmō Sālā ʾəsma yəbē ba-ʾamān tafanawku
verses.notes: **Birth of SHELAH (Ge'ez Sālā).** cf. Gen 10:24, 11:13.

verses.text_geez: ወወለደ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሳላ፡ ሄበር፡ በ፴ ወ፪ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በሳድስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡
verses.translit: wa-walada lottu Sālā Hēbar ba-32 ʾiyobēləwu ba-sādəsə sabuʿ ba-ʿāmat qadāmāwi la-zəntu sabuʿ
verses.notes: **Shelah begets Eber.** Eber = etymology of 'Hebrew' (עברי). cf. Gen 10:24, 11:14-15.

verses.text_geez: ወነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ አዙራድ፡ ወለተ፡ ኔብሮድ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ፋሌቅ፡ እስመ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ሎቱ፡ ተፈለጡ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ ምድረ፡
verses.translit: wa-naśʾa lottu bəʾəsita səmā ʾAzurad walatta Nēbrod bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat la-zəntu sabuʿ wa-samayō səmō Fālēq ʾəsma ba-mawāʿəlu tafalaṭu daqiqa Noḫ mədra
verses.notes: **Birth of PELEG — 'because IN HIS DAYS THE EARTH WAS DIVIDED.'** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — THE DIVISION-OF-EARTH ETYMOLOGY.** Direct citation of Gen 10:25 ('Peleg = niplegah ha-areṣ'). **The earth-division by Noah's lots in Peleg's days** is the structural occasion of ch 8 below.

verses.text_geez: ወጸውዐ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወከፈሎሙ፡ ምድረ፡ በዕፃ፡ በ፴ ወ፫ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡
verses.translit: wa-ṣawʿa Noḫ la-daqiqu wa-kafalomu mədra ba-ʿəḍā ba-33 ʾiyobēləwu ba-qadāmāwi sabuʿ ba-ʿāmat qadāmāwi
verses.notes: **THE LAND-DIVISION-BY-LOT BY NOAH (in Peleg's days).** **MAJOR — Noah divides the earth among his three sons BY LOT — establishing the cosmographic foundation.** Calendrical: jubilee 33, week 1, year 1. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Acts 17:26 ('he determined the boundaries of their dwelling-places'); cf. Deut 32:8 ('when the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he divided humankind, he fixed the boundaries' — MT 'sons of Israel', LXX 'angels of God'). **Jubilees provides the most detailed and earliest extant geographical exposition of the Gen 10 table.**

verses.text_geez: ወወፅአ፡ ዕፁ፡ ለሴም፡ ቀዳሚ፡ መዐርግ፡ ዘበማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ ማእከለ፡ መነጸፍ፡ ለርእስከ፡ ኪደነ፡ መታክፍት፡ ለርእስከ፡ ኪደነ፡ ኤድኒ፡ ምስራቅ፡ ሰፈርከ፡ ወውስተ፡ ግዱፍ፡ ምድር፡ ምስራቅ፡ ኮነ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ኮነ፡ ሰፈርከ፡ ቅዱስ፡
verses.translit: wa-waḍʾa ʿəḍu la-Sēm qadāmi maʿraga zaba-māʾkala mədr māʾkala manaṣaf la-rəʾəsəka kidana matākəft la-rəʾəsəka kidana ʾEdni məsərāq safarka wa-wəsta gədduf mədr məsərāq kona qadāmi kona safarka qəddusə
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 8:9-12; VanderKam 1989) — sense uncertain in Ge'ez; reconstruction follows VanderKam Hermeneia
verses.notes: **Shem's lot falls first — at the CENTER OF THE EARTH.** Sets up Shem-at-center geography developed below.

verses.text_geez: ወከደነ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወባረኮ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይቤ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይትገበር፡ እግዚእ፡ መካነ፡ ለሴም፡ ለክብር፡ ማእከለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-kaddana Noḫ wa-bārakō la-Sēm wa-yəbē buruk ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka Sēm wa-yətgabbar ʾəgziʾ makāna la-Sēm la-kəbər māʾkala mədr
verses.notes: **Noah blesses Shem.** Shem-at-center = elect-people geography.

verses.text_geez: ወወፅአ፡ ጽሕፈት፡ ኀበ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኀበ፡ ሴም፡ ወወዘናሁ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኀደገ፡ ለሴም፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ምድረ፡ ኤዶም፡ እስከ፡ ምድር፡ ምድር፡ ምድር፡ ኤዶም፡
verses.translit: wa-waḍʾa ṣəḥfat ḫaba Noḫ ḫaba Sēm wa-waznāhu la-Noḫ bottu ḫadaga la-Sēm wa-la-daqiqu la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam kwəlo mədr ʾəm-nə mədra ʾEdom ʾəska mədra mədra mədra ʾEdom
verses.notes: **Shem given the elect-territory from Eden eastward.** Eden-as-east anchored.

verses.text_geez: ወወፅአ፡ ዕፃ፡ ለሴም፡ በማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ ዘይነሥእ፡ ለርስት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ እምነ፡ ማእከለ፡ ደብር፡ ራፋ፡ እምነ፡ መውፅአ፡ ፈለግ፡ ቲና፡ ወይከይድ፡ መክፈልቱ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ማእከለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ፈለግ፡ ወይከይድ፡ ኢመቅረቦ፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ ወይከይድ፡ ምድረ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ባሕር፡ እስከ፡ ምድረ፡ ግብጽ፡ ባሕር፡ ዐባይ፡ ወይከይድ፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ወምድረ፡ ሰናኤር፡ ወድልዐ፡ ኤድኒ፡
verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ Σήμ μεσογαίᾳ τῆς γῆς ἣν λαμβάνει εἰς κληρονομίαν αὐτῷ καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος, ἀπὸ τοῦ μέσου τοῦ ὄρους Ῥάφα, ἀπὸ ἐξόδου τοῦ Τίνα ποταμοῦ· καὶ προέρχεται ὁ κλῆρος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ δυσμὰς διὰ μέσου τοῦ ποταμοῦ τούτου, καὶ προέρχεται ἕως ὅτου ἀφικνεῖται εἰς τὴν Ἐρυθρὰν θάλασσαν...
verses.translit: Kai exēlthen ho klēros tō Sēm mesogaia tēs gēs hēn lambanei eis klēronomian autō kai tois teknois autou eis tas geneas tou aiōnos, apo tou mesou tou orous Rapha, apo exodou tou Tina potamou; kai proerchetai ho klēros autou epi dysmas dia mesou tou potamou toutou, kai proerchetai heōs hotou aphikneitai eis tēn Erythran thalassan...
verses.witness_primary: Greek (Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus 21-22, ed. Dean 1935 pp. 64-67) preserves the geographical-allotment description of Shem's territory substantially
verses.notes: **MAJOR — GREEK PATRISTIC WITNESS THROUGH EPIPHANIUS DE MENSURIS ET PONDERIBUS.** **The Greek text here is the principal witness for Jub 8:12-21 (the Shem-territory description).** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — JERUSALEM-AS-OMPHALOS / CENTER-OF-EARTH.** Shem's lot = MIDDLE-OF-EARTH (μεσογαίᾳ τῆς γῆς), running from Mt Rapha to the Tina river (= Tanais / Don river, marking the Europe-Asia boundary in Hellenistic geography), westward to the Erythrean Sea, north to Lebanon, encompassing Eden in its NE corner. **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `jerusalem-as-omphalos-center-of-the-earth-1-enoch-26-cross-corpus`.** **The Jubilees-distinctive sacred-geography places Jerusalem at the OMPHALOS = CENTER of Shem-territory = CENTER of the inhabited world.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Ezek 38:12 ('navel of the earth' = ṭabbur ha-areṣ); cf. Jub 8:19 (explicit identification of Mount Zion as center); cf. 1 En 26 (Enoch's tour identifies a 'blessed land' at center); cf. Pseudo-Eupolemus; cf. rabbinic tradition of Even Shetiyah (foundation stone).

verses.text_geez: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለሴም፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ግብጽ፡ ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ፀሐይ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkayyəd lottu la-Sēm mangala saymən wa-yəkayyəd mangala məsərāq wa-māʾkala məsərāq wa-māʾkala Gəbṣ wa-yəkayyəd mangala məsərāq ʾErtərā bāḥr ʾəska yəkayyəd ḫaba yəwaḍḍəʾ ḍaḥay
verses.notes: **Shem's territory extends to the east — to where the sun rises.** Eastern boundary.

verses.text_geez: ወሴም፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ይሐርሁ፡ ቦቱ፡ ለርእሶሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድር፡ ዘምሥራቅ፡ ኵሉ፡
verses.translit: wa-Sēm wa-wəludu yəḥarrəḥu bottu la-rəʾəsomu kwəlo mədr zaməsərāq kwəlu
verses.notes: **Shem and his sons cultivate the eastern lands.**

verses.text_geez: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ መካን፡ ሠናይ፡ ወክቡር፡ ወኵሉ፡ መካን፡ ዘይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ምድር፡ ሠናይ፡ ወቡሩክ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkayyəd lottu makān śannāy wa-kəbur wa-kwəlu makān zayəkayyəd mangala məsərāq mədr śannāy wa-buruk
verses.notes: **Shem's land = good, glorious, blessed.** Theological-geographical privileging.

verses.text_geez: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ኤላም፡ ወአሱር፡ ወባቤል፡ ወሱስ፡ ወማሕር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘያቆስ፡ መንገለ፡ ቤትባቤል፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkayyəd lottu kwəlu mədra ʾElām wa-ʾAsur wa-Bābēl wa-Sus wa-Māḥr wa-kwəlu mədr zayāqos mangala Bētbābēl
verses.notes: **Shem's specific lands: Elam, Asshur, Babel, Susa, Media (Mahr), and lands toward Babel-region.** Specific east-Mesopotamian + Iranian-plateau territories.

verses.text_geez: ወባረኮ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይቤ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይዕቀብ፡ ሎቱ፡ መካኖ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ እምነ፡ መካን፡ ቅዱስ፡ ዘፈጠረ፡ ሎቱ፡
verses.translit: wa-bārakō Noḫ la-Sēm wa-yəbē buruk ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka Sēm wa-yəʿqab lottu makāno lottu wa-la-daqiqu la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam ʾəm-nə makān qəddus zafaṭara lottu
verses.notes: **Noah blesses Shem with permanent possession of holy land.** Shem-as-elect-line.

verses.text_geez: ወአእመረ፡ ኖኅ፡ ከመ፡ መካን፡ ቡሩክ፡ ወመክፈልት፡ ቡሩክ፡ ወድቀ፡ ለሴም፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ኤዶም፡ ውስተ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ሕንድ፡ ወውስተ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ዘይከይድ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaʾəmara Noḫ kama makān buruk wa-makfalt buruk wadqa la-Sēm wa-la-daqiqu la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam kwəlu mədra ʾEdom wəsta məsərāq wa-kwəlu mədr məsərāq wa-mangala Hənd wa-wəsta ʾErtərā zayəkayyəd
verses.notes: **'Noah knew that a blessed land fell to Shem... including Eden in the east + India + Erythrean Sea region.'** **MAJOR — JUBILEES SACRED-GEOGRAPHY: EDEN + INDIA + RED-SEA region all in Shem-territory.** This is the principal Asia-as-Shem mapping.

verses.text_geez: ወአእመረ፡ ኖኅ፡ ከመ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ቅድስት፡ ቅዱሳት፡ ይእቲ፡ ወምኅደረ፡ እግዚእ፡ ወደብረ፡ ሲና፡ ማእከለ፡ ገዳም፡ ወደብረ፡ ጽዮን፡ ማእከለ፡ ሕንባል፡ ምድር፡ ፫ እማንቱ፡ ቅድስት፡ ቅዱሳት፡ ቅሩብ፡ አሐዱ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaʾəmara Noḫ kama ganata ʾEdom qəddəstə qəddusāt yəʾəti wa-məḫdara ʾəgziʾ wa-dabra Sina māʾkala gadām wa-dabra Ṣəyon māʾkala ḥənbal mədr 3 ʾəmāntu qəddəstə qəddusāt qərrub ʾaḥadu məsla kāləʾu
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 8:19; VanderKam 1989); Greek (Epiphanius) preserves substantial portion
verses.notes: **EDEN + SINAI + ZION — THREE COSMIC HOLY MOUNTAINS. ZION = NAVEL/CENTER OF THE EARTH (ḥənbal mədr).** **MAJOR — THE JERUSALEM-OMPHALOS LOCUS CLASSICUS.** **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `jerusalem-as-omphalos-center-of-the-earth-1-enoch-26-cross-corpus`.** Ge'ez **ḥənbal mədr** = 'navel of the earth' translates Hebrew tabbur ha-areṣ (cf. Ezek 38:12, Judg 9:37). **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Jub 4:26 (the four cosmic holy mountains); cf. Ezek 5:5 ('I set Jerusalem in the midst of the nations'); cf. 1 En 26:1-2 (the central place with the Tree); cf. rabbinic tradition of Even Shetiyah ('foundation stone' at Temple Mount center); cf. medieval T-O maps placing Jerusalem at world-center.

verses.text_geez: ወባረኮ፡ ለአምላከ፡ ሰማይ፡ ለሊቀ፡ ኪዳኑ፡ እስመ፡ ፈለጠ፡ መካናተ፡ ቅዱሳተ፡ ለርእሱ፡
verses.translit: wa-bārakō la-ʾamlāka samāy la-liqa kidānu ʾəsma falaṭa makānāta qəddusāta la-rəʾəsu
verses.notes: **Noah praises God who separated holy places for himself.**

verses.text_geez: ወባረከ፡ ቡሩክ፡ ለእግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይሥራዕ፡ እግዚእ፡ መካናተ፡ ቅዱሳተ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይነብር፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: wa-bārakō buruk la-ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka Sēm wa-yəśrāʿ ʾəgziʾ makānāta qəddusāta la-Sēm wa-yənabbər ʾəska la-ʿālam
verses.notes: **Blessed Shem with holy-place ownership forever.**

verses.text_geez: ወወፅአ፡ ዕፁ፡ ለሐም፡ ካዕበ፡ ለርእስ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ ዘመክፈልት፡ መንገለ፡ ጊዮን፡ ፈለግ፡ መንገለ፡ ደቡብ፡ ኀበ፡ የማን፡ ኬዶሮ፡ ወይከይድ፡ ኵሉ፡ መንገለ፡ የማን፡ ዐውዶ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሐም፡
verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ Χάμ ὥστε γενέσθαι αὐτῷ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος μερὶς πρὸς μεσημβρίαν, ἀπὸ τοῦ Γηῶν ποταμοῦ ἕως ἀνατολῶν...
verses.translit: Kai exēlthen ho klēros tō Cham hōste genesthai autō kai tois huiois autou eis tas geneas tou aiōnos meris pros mesēmbrian, apo tou Gēōn potamou heōs anatolōn...
verses.witness_primary: Greek (Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus 23, ed. Dean 1935 pp. 67-69) preserves the geographical-allotment description of Ham's territory substantially
verses.notes: **HAM'S LOT — south of the Gihon river, all of southern Africa.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — HAM = AFRICA mapping.** Gihon (Gen 2:13) understood as the NILE in Jubilees-geography. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Josephus Ant. 1.39 (Gihon = Nile); cf. Sirach 24:27 (Gihon-Nile pairing). **The Africa-to-Ham mapping is foundational in subsequent Jewish + Christian cosmography.**

verses.text_geez: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ኬዶሮ፡ ምድር፡ ዘይከይድ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለፈለግ፡ ጊዮን፡ ወይከይድ፡ ለሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘመንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ እምነ፡ ጊዮን፡ ፈለግ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkayyəd lottu kwəlu mədr Kēdoro mədr zayəkayyəd qərruba la-falag Giyon wa-yəkayyəd la-lottu kwəlu mədr zamangala məʿrāb ʾəm-nə Giyon falag
verses.notes: **Ham's land extends west of the Gihon (Nile).** All sub-Saharan + west-African territory.

verses.text_geez: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ መንገለ፡ የማን፡ ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ መንገለ፡ ባሕር፡ አፉና፡ ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ምስለ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ ዘውስቴታ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkayyəd lottu mangala yamān wa-yəkayyəd mangala məʿrāb mangala bāḥr ʾAfunā wa-yəkayyəd lottu mədr mangala məʿrāb məsla ʾErtərā bāḥr zawəstatēhā
verses.notes: **Ham extends to western seas + Erythraean Sea (Red Sea / Indian Ocean).** Full African + western-Indian-Ocean territory.

verses.text_geez: ወወፅአ፡ ዕፁ፡ ለያፌት፡ ካዕበ፡ ለርእስ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ መክፈልት፡ ምዕራብ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ መንገለ፡ መጋጎግ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘመንገለ፡ ሰሜኖ፡ ለቲና፡ ፈለግ፡
verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ Ἰάφεθ ὥστε γενέσθαι αὐτῷ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος μερὶς πρὸς ἄρκτον ἐπὶ δυσμάς, βορρᾶν τοῦ Τίνα ποταμοῦ...
verses.translit: Kai exēlthen ho klēros tō Iapheth hōste genesthai autō kai tois huiois autou eis tas geneas tou aiōnos meris pros arkton epi dysmas, borran tou Tina potamou...
verses.witness_primary: Greek (Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus 24, ed. Dean 1935 pp. 69-71) preserves the geographical-allotment description of Japhet's territory substantially
verses.notes: **JAPHET'S LOT — NORTH OF THE TINA RIVER (Don/Tanais) = ALL EUROPE + NORTHERN STEPPE.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — JAPHET = EUROPE + NORTH mapping.** The Tina = Hellenistic Tanais = Don River = the canonical Europe/Asia boundary. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Josephus Ant. 1.122-129 (Japhet's sons in Europe + northern Asia).

verses.text_geez: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ዘመዓዶ፡ ለቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ ዘይከይድ፡ ይውድቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ጲንቶስ፡ ባሕር፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkayyəd lottu kwəlu mədr mangala məʿrāb zamaʿādo la-Tinā falag zayəkayyəd yəwadəq wəsta Pəntos bāḥr
verses.notes: **Japhet's lands extend to the Pontus Sea (Black Sea).** Continuing northward + westward.

verses.text_geez: ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ መንገለ፡ ቤትፋራም፡ ወፋርሰ፡ ድልዕ፡ ወይከይድ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለፈለግ፡ ቲና፡ ወይከይድ፡ ለማእከለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ብሔር፡ ወያእለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ይከይድ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkayyəd mangala məʿrāb mangala Bētfārām wa-Fārs dəlʿ wa-yəkayyəd qərruba la-falag Tinā wa-yəkayyəd la-māʾkala məʿrāb bəḥēr wa-yāʾəla saymən yəkayyəd
verses.notes: **Japhet's western territories.** Detailed boundary.

verses.text_geez: ወያእለ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ይከይድ፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ መካን፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ኀበ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡
verses.translit: wa-yāʾəla kwəlo mangala məʿrāb yəkayyəd ʾəska yəkayyəd ḫaba makān mangala məʿrāb ḫaba yəkayyəd ʾErtərā bāḥr
verses.notes: **Japhet to western ocean.**

verses.text_geez: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወሐ፬፡ ደሰያት፡ ዐበይተ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkayyəd lottu kwəlo mangala məʿrāb wa-mangala saymən kwəlo mədr mangala saymən wa-4 dasayāt ʿabayta
verses.notes: **Japhet receives four great islands** (the British Isles / Mediterranean islands?). Detail of island-allocation.

verses.text_geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ቅርሕም፡ መካኑ፡ ወቍርና፡ ለመክፈልቱ፡ ዘያፌት፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሐም፡ መካን፡ ምውቅ፡ ወምድር፡ ዘሴም፡ ሞቃር፡ ወዘያፌት፡ ቍሩር፡
verses.translit: wa-bāḥtu qərḥəm makānu wa-qwərna la-makfaltu zayāfet ʾəm-nə mədr zaḥam makān məwq wa-mədr zasēm moqar wa-zayāfet quwər
verses.notes: **Climatic-classification of the three continents: HAM = HOT; SHEM = TEMPERATE; JAPHET = COLD.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — HELLENISTIC CLIMATE-ZONE GEOGRAPHY.** This climatic tripartition is the standard Greek cosmography (cf. Aristotle Meteorologica 2.5, Strabo, Ptolemy). Jubilees-distinctive: SHEM gets the TEMPERATE = optimal zone — theological geography. Closes chapter 8.
